items.title: BIBA and Intact Insurance launch Start-Up Hub for brokers
items.summary: The British Insurance Brokers' Association and Intact Insurance have introduced a new resource to assist aspiring brokers with establishing and growing new brokerages.

items.title: Nvidia shares fall as CEO Jensen Huang resigns
items.summary: Nvidia shares plunged more than thirteen percent at market open following the resignation of chief executive Jensen Huang.

items.title: FCA proposes excluding some performance fees from DC default charge cap
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has launched a consultation on exempting certain performance-linked fees from the defined contribution default fund charge cap.

items.title: Former broking boss Chris Giles dies aged 62
items.summary: Tributes have been paid following the death of former Giles Insurance CEO and PIB co-founder Chris Giles at the London Clinic.

items.title: Nick Hopkin discusses broker specialisms in latest Insurance Age series
items.summary: The Broker Investment Group strategic development director Nick Hopkin features in the latest Broker Expo Bites episode to discuss trading strategies and insurer partnerships.

items.title: Society of Pension Professionals poll identifies VfM as primary retirement driver
items.summary: Research from the Society of Pension Professionals indicates that 44% of surveyed industry professionals view the value for money framework as the key driver for better saver outcomes.
